changes: Initial open source release of ClipGenAI.
Zero-click clipboard listener routing copied text directly to Gemini 2.5 Flash.
Floating glassmorphic HUD bubble anchored at bottom-right or top-right with auto-dismiss and pin modes.
Quick action buttons: 1-click clipboard copyback, dismiss, pin, and 6 persona switches.
Secure Gemini API Key storage via macOS Keychain (com.aoh.clipgenai) with live test verification.
Integrated In-App Update Checker with GitHub Releases and one-liner local installer.
